subject.title: feat(browser): normalize ChatGPT Work sessions to Chat

question: Should Oracle browser automation enforce Chat-only semantics for confirmed Work conversations, resetting non-resume attachments and rejecting explicit resumes?
rationale: Current main has no established Work-session contract, and the branch deliberately changes valid attached and resume workflows even though its implementation is technically careful and proven.

options.title: Enforce Chat-only semantics
options.body: Merge the verified normalization and define confirmed Work conversations as unsupported for ordinary Oracle Chat runs.

options.title: Defer attachment policy
options.body: Keep visible home-page mode switching but preserve attached and resumed Work conversations until Work-session support is decided separately.

recommendation.title: Enforce Chat-only semantics
recommendation.body: Merge the verified normalization and define confirmed Work conversations as unsupported for ordinary Oracle Chat runs.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest ownership signal across browser startup, navigation, adjacent compatibility fixes, and recent browser-feature merges.
